name: apiResponses
description: API gateway requests over time for a project, split by service and HTTP status class so error rates can be charted

getArgs.value: select toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL {{ ({ last1hour: '5 minute', last12hours: '30 minute' })[timeframe.enum] || '1 hour' }}) as bucket, multiIf(position(splitByString(' | ', event_message)[3], '/rest/v1') > 0, 'Data API', position(splitByString(' | ', event_message)[3], '/auth/v1') > 0, 'Auth', position(splitByString(' | ', event_message)[3], '/storage/v1') > 0, 'Storage', position(splitByString(' | ', event_message)[3], '/realtime/v1') > 0, 'Realtime', position(splitByString(' | ', event_message)[3], '/functions/v1') > 0, 'Edge Functions', position(splitByString(' | ', event_message)[3], '/graphql/v1') > 0, 'GraphQL', 'Other') as service, concat(substring(splitByString(' | ', event_message)[2], 1, 1), 'xx') as status_class, count() as requests from logs where source = 'edge_logs' group by bucket, service, status_class order by bucket desc
